author: The Current
description: Ahead of the announced A Concert of Solidarity & Resistance to Defend Minnesota benefit show talking place on Friday, Jan. 30, at noon at First Avenue in Minneapolis, Tom Morello (Rage Against the Machine, Audioslave, The Nightwatchman) talks about his admiration for "artists who show up."
title: Tom Morello gives props to "artists who show up"

author: The Current
description: Tom Morello (Rage Against the Machine, Audioslave, The Nightwatchman) talks with The Current's Jill Riley about the inspiration for the benefit show, A Concert Concert of Solidarity & Resistance to Defend Minnesota, happening Friday, Jan. 30, at noon at First Avenue in Minneapolis. "We are so inspired by the way that the people of Minneapolis have stood up to tyranny and stood up to injustice," Morello says.
title: Tom Morello talks about inspiration for Minneapolis benefit concert
